newsitem.title: DENMARK: Den Danske Bank opens office in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Den Danske Bank opens office in Poland.

text.p: Denmark's Den Danske Bank said on Monday it had opened a representative office in Warsaw as a first step towards establishing itself in eastern Europe at a time of growing trade between the Nordic region and Poland.
"The many Nordic companies operating on the Polish market will be the main beneficiaries of the services to be provided," the bank said in a statement.
According to a Danske Bank executive, there were no current plans to open a branch of the bank in the Polish capital but he said it was a future possibility.
"We have no concrete plans to open a branch at the moment but we could well imagine doing so with time," he said.
"We have opened in Poland to help Danish firms operating there and get acquainted with the Polish market," he said.
He said there were 264 Danish, 325 Swedish and 38 Norwegian firms established in Poland at the present time. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
